map.总能量 E = N × E_f；单次铀 235 裂变释放约 200 MeV（约: Total energy E = N x E_f; a single uranium-235 fission releases about 200 MeV (about 3.2 × 10⁻¹¹ J); 1 kg of uranium-235 contains about 2.56 × 10²⁴ nuclei, so complete fission yields about 8.2 × 10¹³ J, equivalent to roughly 2000 tonnes of standard coal. Each fission also releases 2 to 3 neutrons, with the energy split into about 168 MeV of fragment kinetic energy, about 5 MeV carried by neutrons and about 7 to 15 MeV of gamma rays; nuclear fuel has an energy density about 10⁶ times that of fossil fuels.
